title: YOUR PRIVATE GARDEN ESCAPE IN THE HEART OF DUBAI
description:
WHERE CITY LIFE FINDS ITS OWN GARDEN RETREAT

What if you could enjoy the pulse of Dubai without giving up the peace of coming home?

Imagine beginning your morning surrounded by natural light, elegant interiors, and a sense of calm that makes the rest of the world feel a little less hurried. Step outside, and the city is waiting. Return home, and discover a different rhythm — one shaped by greenery, comfort, and the pleasure of having a place that truly feels yours.

Welcome to Chelsea Gardens, a distinctive residential address in Jumeirah Garden City, where contemporary elegance meets the charm of garden-inspired living.

Here, every day brings a new opportunity to enjoy life your way. Start with an energising workout, take a refreshing swim in the infinity pool, or find your moment of peace in the wellness and yoga spaces. Spend a relaxing afternoon in the landscaped gardens, enjoy time with family in the dedicated children's play area, or simply unwind in the residents' lounge. Every corner invites you to slow down, reconnect, and appreciate the little things that make a home special.

Inside, thoughtful layouts and refined finishes create a welcoming atmosphere, with residences ranging from studios to one- and two-bedroom apartments. Inspired by Art Nouveau influences, the design brings together graceful details, contemporary character, and a sense of timeless style. Selected interiors feature premium touches, including Bosch kitchen appliances and Grohe fittings.

And beyond your private retreat, Dubai opens up around you. With Sheikh Zayed Road just moments away, you are approximately three minutes from DIFC and five minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa. Shopping, business, dining, and the city's most celebrated destinations are all within convenient reach.

Chelsea Gardens is where you can stay close to everything that moves Dubai, while finding the space to enjoy everything that makes life beautiful.

Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

Location and Connectivity:

Vue Doree sits within Dubai Islands, a Nakheel-masterplanned archipelago of five interconnected islands along Dubai's northern coastline. The community is designed to deliver over 20 kilometres of beaches, including a Blue Flag-certified beach, alongside parks, cycling paths, marina walkways, and car-free waterfront promenades. The planned Deira Mall, an expansive retail destination, alongside a renowned night market with over 5,300 shops and quayside cafes, will anchor the community's retail and dining offer. The historic Gold Souk and Spice Souk of Deira are also a short drive away.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. description:
WHERE EVERY DAY FEELS LIKE A GETAWAY

Imagine waking up in the heart of Dubai, where the city's vibrant energy meets the effortless spirit of coastal living.

The morning begins with sunlight pouring through floor-to-ceiling windows, illuminating warm interiors designed to make you feel instantly at home. As the afternoon arrives, the pool and sun deck become your escape. Perhaps you prefer a moment of tranquillity in the sauna and steam room, or an active afternoon in the indoor or outdoor gym. Later, gather with friends around the BBQ area, enjoy the rooftop lounge overlooking Dubai's skyline, or settle in for a movie beneath the stars at the outdoor cinema. Inside, contemporary design meets thoughtful functionality. For an even more exclusive experience, selected residences feature private pools, bringing the feeling of a private retreat right to your doorstep.

And when you are ready to explore, Dubai is all around you. Jumeirah Beach, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and the city's most vibrant destinations are within convenient reach, with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road.

description: Luxurious Sea-View Flats with Private Beach Access on Dubai Islands The development is located within Dubai Islands, a premium waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, designed to offer beachside living with convenient access to the mainland. Its island setting provides a resort atmosphere while remaining well-connected to the city. Social amenities include an infinity swimming pool with a leisure deck, a jacuzzi, a childrens pool and play areas, a fully equipped gym, yoga space, outdoor cinema, BBQ areas, landscaped relaxation zones, hammock garden, and a community garden. Buyers are drawn to the Dubai Islands because it offers a rare combination of beachfront living, limited supply, and strong future growth potential within a master-planned island destination. From an investment and lifestyle perspective, purchasing property in Dubai offers access to a globally recognized real estate market that combines modern infrastructure, safety, and high living standards. The city supports foreign ownership in designated areas and regulates off-plan developments through escrow systems designed to protect buyers. title: Rare 3-Bed with Golf and City Views in Ras Al Khor
raw_area: Sobha One Tower C, Sobha One, Ras Al Khor Industrial 1, Ras Al Khor, Dubai
description:
This exquisite duplex within Sobha One sits beside Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, offering a peaceful setting in the heart of one of Dubai’s emerging destinations for community-led living. The home unfolds across two storeys, spanning 2,298 sq ft, with the lower level largely occupied by an open-plan living space and a stunning floating infinity-ribbon glass chandelier. There is ample space for distinct seating areas, with tucked-away sofas in proximity to the entertainment unit. Warm almond tones spread throughout the space, creating a cosy, sophisticated atmosphere, while a combination of muted white and walnut tones shapes the architecture.

The Tour

This home sits within a marvellous ecosystem by Sobha Realty, where every structure is surrounded by greenery and the potted planting of the shared courtyard outside. A private door leads through the entrance, opening into a bright, double-height living space. To one side, stairs ascend to the spectacular first- and second-floor living spaces.


The Area

Ras Al Khor is becoming one of Dubai’s most exciting new residential and lifestyle destinations. Located close to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Creek Harbour, it offers convenience alongside a quieter, more open setting. Dubai International Airport and Business Bay are both approximately 12 minutes away, while the city’s major road networks remain within easy reach. The area’s golf-course views, landscaped surroundings, and proximity to Dubai Creek add to its long-term appeal.

What We Like

• Rare duplex layout

• Views across the golf course and Dubai skyline

• Well-connected location in the emerging Ras Al Khor district

description: This is not a two-bedroom apartment with a generous balcony. It is a 3,302.26 sq ft (306.79 m²) private-pool residence whose outdoor space is larger than its entire interior. Set on the seventh floor of Aqua Arc, the corner plan combines sea and internal-landscape views with a remarkable 2,099.39 sq ft private terrace and an asking price of AED 8,558,998. The pool belongs to the residence and occupies the outer arc of the terrace. It is not several floors away within a shared amenity deck. That single distinction changes how the home can be used: the outdoor space becomes a private setting for quiet mornings, open-air dining and evenings hosted above Al Marjan Island. Inside, the 1,202.87 sq ft (111.75 m²) suite is planned as a complete two-bedroom home. The entrance creates a clear transition into the living areas, with a 2.0 by 2.5 metre kitchen connecting naturally to the 4.6 by 5.2 metre living and dining room. The curved frontage draws the eye toward the terrace, allowing the interior to remain visually connected with the pool and the changing outlook beyond it. The private accommodation sits away from the main social space. The principal bedroom measures 3.8 by 4.2 metres and is paired with a substantial 2.8 by 3.6 metre bathroom. The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. A separate powder room keeps guest use away from the bedroom accommodation, while a dedicated laundry preserves the kitchen as part of the home's entertaining space. The terrace is the defining room. At approximately 195.04 m², it offers enough breadth to compose several outdoor zones instead of forcing every activity into one arrangement. There is scope for dining near the living room, a more relaxed lounge along the curved frontage and sun loungers beside the private pool. These are potential uses rather than included furnishings, but the physical proportions make each possible without compromising circulation. The seventh-floor corner position gives the residence two distinct outlooks. One aspect turns toward the sea; the other takes in Aqua Arc's internal landscape. The view therefore develops as one moves around the terrace rather than presenting a single fixed elevation. Together with the pool and the sweep of the architecture, that dual aspect gives the apartment a sense of privacy and occasion normally associated with a resort home. Aqua Arc's design is shaped by flowing façades, wave-inspired balconies and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones, allowing the water and natural light to remain central to the experience. Project visuals show the intended design language; final materials, fixtures, appliances and furniture must follow the executed sale documents. The planned amenity programme includes indoor and outdoor fitness areas, walking trails, recreational lawns, barbecue facilities, a pool bar, steam and sauna facilities, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. For an international second-home buyer, this residence offers the outdoor life of a private resort property within an apartment format. For a long-term purchaser, its proposition rests on rare, visible attributes rather than a forecast return: more than 306 m² of total space, a private-pool terrace larger than the interior, a seventh-floor corner position and two verified outlooks. Expected completion is Q3 2027, subject to the sale documents. title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: 77PX+69, Dubai
description: Ocean Crest is an elegant coastal residential development that brings together contemporary sophistication and the tranquillity of waterfront living. Thoughtfully designed to reflect the natural beauty of its surroundings, the residences feature a harmonious blend of soft textures, natural light, and timeless colour palettes. Every element is carefully considered to create an inviting atmosphere where modern aesthetics meet comfort, offering residents a peaceful retreat inspired by the rhythm of the sea. The development embraces a refined approach to residential living, with welcoming interiors and thoughtfully planned spaces that balance elegance with functionality. Living areas transition seamlessly into private spaces, creating a natural flow throughout each residence. Contemporary detailing, carefully selected materials, and a calming design philosophy contribute to an environment that feels both sophisticated and effortlessly comfortable, providing an ideal setting for relaxation and everyday living. Beyond the residences, Ocean Crest offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance wellness, leisure, and relaxation. Dedicated wellness facilities and inviting recreational spaces create opportunities to unwind, recharge, and enjoy a balanced lifestyle. With its coastal-inspired atmosphere and emphasis on comfort, the development offers more than a home-it presents a lifestyle shaped by tranquillity, contemporary design, and the appeal of seaside living. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an emerging waterfront destination designed to bring together coastal living, contemporary residences, hospitality, and leisure within an expansive island setting. Comprising five interconnected islands, the master development features an extensive coastline, scenic beaches, landscaped open spaces, and thoughtfully planned residential and recreational districts. Its distinctive setting offers a refreshing alternative to the city's fast-paced urban environment while maintaining access to Dubai's established lifestyle and business destinations. The destination is envisioned as a comprehensive lifestyle community, with plans for luxury resorts, marinas, beachfront leisure, dining destinations, and retail experiences. Residents can enjoy opportunities for outdoor recreation, including beach activities, water sports, and yachting, alongside landscaped parks and spaces for relaxation. This combination of natural surroundings and lifestyle attractions contributes to the area's appeal for those seeking a contemporary waterfront address. Dubai Islands also benefits from road connections linking the island development to mainland Dubai, supporting access to key destinations across the city. Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and the traditional commercial districts around Deira are accessible by road, while public transport connectivity continues to develop alongside the wider area. Combining coastal scenery, evolving infrastructure, and an expanding collection of lifestyle attractions, Dubai Islands presents an appealing destination for those seeking modern seaside living in Dubai.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

At 9 PM, the building turns into a resort.

You leave the kids with family and go down to the Sauna & Steam Room to melt the day away. Then you meet your neighbors in the Private Cinema. Popcorn. Big screen. No tickets.

You go back to your apartment

The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. description: Ready to Move Apartments with Post-Handover Installments in Business Bay Business Bay is one of Dubai's most prestigious and dynamic neighborhoods, known for its sleek skyscrapers, vibrant lifestyle, and proximity to major landmarks like Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa. Situated along the Dubai Canal, it offers a perfect blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, making it a top choice for professionals and families alike. Advanced smart home automation is seamlessly integrated, allowing residents to control lighting, climate, blinds, multimedia, and even guest parking from touch panels or a mobile app. Bathrooms include elegant finishes and mood lighting, while the overall design emphasizes energy, flow, and a joyful, balanced lifestyle within a sophisticated urban sanctuary. title: Lagoon-Facing 1-Bed Apartment at Claydon House
description:
A stunning one-bedroom home with lagoon views to one side and Downtown Dubai on the horizon - this mid-floor apartment at Claydon House offers a serene and compelling proposition. Part of Ellington’s Meydan Horizon community, it features two bathrooms, a smart open-plan layout, and a genuine sense of resort-style living, ideal for anyone looking for space, light, and picturesque views without stepping into a villa-sized budget.

The Tour

The building’s interiors strike an impression from the moment you enter the reception doors. Claydon House has a lobby dressed in warm taupe and grey marble. Sculptural open shelving, soft sofas and marble-topped coffee tables sit to either side, all creating a polished, hotel-like feel before the lift takes you up to the residences.

WHEN THE FOREST BECOMES PART OF YOUR EVERYDAY LIFE

Imagine waking up in Dubai...

Not to the sound of traffic, not to concrete stretching endlessly across the horizon, but to a different kind of morning — one surrounded by trees, fresh air and the quiet feeling that nature is finally part of your everyday life.

This is the story of Lyra at Ghaf Woods.

Set within one of Dubai's most distinctive forest-inspired communities, Lyra introduces a new way of experiencing urban living. Here, your home doesn't simply stand within a neighbourhood. It becomes part of a landscape designed around greenery, movement, wellbeing and connection.

Step inside your residence and the feeling continues.

Contemporary interiors open towards natural light, creating a calm and elegant setting where the outside world feels beautifully close. Whether you choose a one- or two-bedroom residence, the spaces are designed for modern life while keeping a sense of warmth and privacy.

Then, instead of taking the elevator down into another concrete cityscape, you step outside into something different.

Walk beneath the trees.

Take your morning run along the trails.

Cycle through the landscape.

Pause beside the forest pools.

Let the children discover their own world through nature gardens and outdoor spaces, while you find a quiet moment for yourself at the wellness and yoga pavilion.

At Ghaf Woods, nature is not decoration.

It is the lifestyle.

And when you want to reconnect with the energy of Dubai, the city remains within easy reach, with Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road nearby.

Lyra is for those who want a home that feels different the moment they arrive — a place where mornings are calmer, evenings feel lighter and everyday life has room to breathe.

Because sometimes, the greatest luxury in a city like Dubai isn't being closer to everything.

It's having a place where you can finally slow down.

description: Elegant Flats with Resort-Style Amenities in Ras Al Khaimah Downtown Mina in Ras Al Khaimah represents a beautiful fusion of vibrant urban activity and serene coastal tranquility. Once defined by 18 kilometers of pristine shoreline, this premium island has evolved into a highly desirable residential destination shaped by connections, design, and light. Seamlessly linking a vibrant pedestrian boulevard, lush landscaped parks, and a world-class marina, it offers an exclusive lifestyle where city pace meets island calm. Residents are surrounded by beautiful natural mangroves filled with native wildlife, with the steady backdrop of the Hajar Mountains. The flats in Ras Al Khaimah for sale are situated just a 10-minute drive away from the highly anticipated Wynn Casino and only 15 minutes from the iconic Al Marjan Island. Travel is effortless with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport reachable within 15 to 20 minutes. Furthermore, Dubai International Airport (DXB) is a smooth 45 to 60-minute drive, and Zayed International Airport in Abu Dhabi is accessible in 125 minutes. The residential complex features an outstanding collection of outdoor and indoor amenities designed for health, recreation, and social connection. Outdoors, residents can enjoy a 25-meter main lap pool, a kids splash area, a jogging track, and an outdoor fitness gym. The beautifully landscaped gardens also include a padel court, a mini-golf course, a skate park, and a dedicated pet park. Indoors, the double-height grand lobby welcomes you to a multipurpose clubhouse, co-working spaces, a premium yoga studio, and a curated art gallery. Every flat is beautifully designed, starting from compact studios up to spectacular four-bedroom penthouses, offering breathtaking views. Built with smart home automation for lighting and climate control, the residences offer peak modern convenience. Sustainability is prioritized through energy-saving LED fixtures and high-efficiency VRF HVAC technology. The interiors showcase premium craftsmanship, high-quality finishes, and expansive double-glazed thermal windows that frame the sea, park, or marina, providing an abundance of natural light. title: 2-Bed Corner Unit in Binghatti Flare, JVT
raw_area: Binghatti Flare, District 2, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai
description:
Designed in enchanting symmetry, this corner unit apartment, offering 1,543 square feet in Binghatti Flare Tower 1, nestled in Jumeirah Village Triangle, is a modern-finished residence showcasing the developer’s impetus to bring new designs and structures to a community that has now become one of Dubai’s most reliable investment plays. Considerate two bedrooms and two bathrooms make this space an ideal setting for everyday living. A modest lobby, finished in travertine and warm brass, brings a sense of openness, making it look much more like a boutique hotel than a standard residential entrance.

The Tour

Upon arrival, the living area gently flows into the outdoor terrace area, offering exotic views of the cityscape. The home has beautifully planned details and resplendent architecture, all in walnut-chestnut shades, with warm, moody lighting that gives the space a peaceful aura. The kitchen sits in the centre and, at first glance, feels like part of the living area, and that is the success of thoughtful planning. It continues the same tactile, textured palette, with a central island in warm stone and integrated appliances.

The Area

Jumeirah Village Triangle is well positioned between Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, placing Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai and other key destinations within convenient reach. The community supports an active, family-friendly lifestyle with parks, playgrounds, open spaces and sports facilities, including basketball and tennis courts, alongside nearby gyms in Jumeirah Park and JVC. It is also pet-friendly, with green spaces and designated areas for dog walking and exercise, while schools, pharmacies, supermarkets and restaurants make everyday living effortless.

What We Like

A true corner layout at 1,543 sq ft

JVT's established infrastructure and central position between Marina and Downtown

A boutique-hotel-style arrival experience

They ask, "How much did this cost?"

You smile again. Because you bought it before everyone else realized — *Arjan is not the future. It's the smart money right now.*

*This isn't a property. It's the moment your life got an upgrade.*

title: Emaar Oria
description: "Oria is a contemporary residential development by Emaar Properties located in Dubai Creek Harbour, adjacent to the Creek Beach district. The project comprises 163 residential units, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with total areas ranging from approximately 749 to 1,727 sq ft. The development features a waterfront-oriented setting with a creekside promenade and views of the district park and Creek Beach. Residents can enjoy access to recreational facilities, including children's play areas, an adventure playground, a cycling track, a skate park and sports courts, along with connections to public transportation, including an RTA ferry terminal and metro station. Starting prices are AED 1.7 million for one-bedroom apartments, AED 2.7 million for two-bedroom apartments and AED 3.7 million for three-bedroom apartments. The apartments feature balconies, while selected two-bedroom layouts include walk-in closets and the documented three-bedroom layouts offer walk-in closets, laundry rooms and study areas. Oria's location provides convenient access to key destinations across Dubai, with Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary approximately five minutes away, Downtown Dubai around 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport approximately 15 minutes away and Al Maktoum International Airport around 35 minutes away. The development's staged payment plan extends from February 2024 through July 2028, incorporating construction-related milestones. Oria combines contemporary apartment living, recreational amenities and waterfront surroundings within the wider Dubai Creek Harbour community."

Every element has been composed around one idea: life should move beautifully.

Sky Harmony is where Italian design meets the rhythm of Dubai, where comfort meets sophistication, and where your home becomes more than a place to return to.

It becomes the place where your life finds its perfect harmony.

title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1215. Discover a new residential icon in the heart of Dubai, a 450-metre-tall, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Situated on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this development elevates the urban experience by combining architectural elegance, endless views, and a direct connection to the city's most relevant areas. Just minutes from Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown and Jumeirah Beach, it offers a prime location that ensures mobility, convenience and the possibility of living in the centre of it all. The building comprises 684 residences, spread between one- to four-bedroom apartments and exclusive duplexes, each designed as a tranquil refuge elevated above the urban hustle and bustle. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto the sea and skyline, providing abundant natural light and a continuous sense of spaciousness. Private balconies extend this connection to the landscape, while interior finishes including porcelain floors, fully equipped kitchens with appliances from recognised brands and bathrooms with premium materials guarantee comfort, quality and sophistication in every detail. The integrated technology allows you to control light and air conditioning, transforming each residence into a modern and functional space. The tower also stands out for its four sky-parks, distributed vertically and created to offer distinct worlds suspended in the air. The first is dedicated to family energy, with leisure spaces, activities for children, play areas and sports areas that promote moments of conviviality. The second focuses on well-being, with three levels that bring together a running track, training areas, yoga areas and garden terraces, creating perfect environments for both physical activity and moments of leisure. The third is a quiet refuge full of vegetation, sensory paths, glass pavilions and quiet corners that invite reading, reflection and rest. The room, situated at about 370 meters high, offers a suspended resort atmosphere, with an infinity pool, floating deck and spaces intended to relax while the horizon lights up with the sunset. The experience begins right in the lobby, a space designed to convey serenity and grandeur through the careful use of stone, wood and metal elements that filter light in a gentle way, creating a feeling of warmth even before entering the house. The entire building was developed to convey harmony, verticality and lightness, transforming each route from the arrival at the lobby to the highest levels into a natural extension of contemporary urban life. Scheduled for completion in December 2031, this development represents a unique investment opportunity in one of Dubai's most impressive and elevated residential projects. Here, every detail has been thought out to offer a distinctive, modern and balanced life, where the sky becomes part of everyday life and the city stretches out from your feet. #ref:8952

description: Elegant Flats with Resort-Style Amenities in Ras Al Khaimah Downtown Mina in Ras Al Khaimah represents a beautiful fusion of vibrant urban activity and serene coastal tranquility. Once defined by 18 kilometers of pristine shoreline, this premium island has evolved into a highly desirable residential destination shaped by connections, design, and light. Seamlessly linking a vibrant pedestrian boulevard, lush landscaped parks, and a world-class marina, it offers an exclusive lifestyle where city pace meets island calm. Residents are surrounded by beautiful natural mangroves filled with native wildlife, with the steady backdrop of the Hajar Mountains. The are situated just a 10-minute drive away from the highly anticipated Wynn Casino and only 15 minutes from the iconic Al Marjan Island. Travel is effortless with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport reachable within 15 to 20 minutes. Furthermore, Dubai International Airport (DXB) is a smooth 45 to 60-minute drive, and Zayed International Airport in Abu Dhabi is accessible in 125 minutes. The residential complex features an outstanding collection of outdoor and indoor amenities designed for health, recreation, and social connection. Outdoors, residents can enjoy a 25-meter main lap pool, a kid's splash area, a jogging track, and an outdoor fitness gym. The beautifully landscaped gardens also include a padel court, a mini-golf course, a skate park, and a dedicated pet park. Indoors, the double-height grand lobby welcomes you to a multipurpose clubhouse, co-working spaces, a premium yoga studio, and a curated art gallery. Every flat is beautifully designed, starting from compact studios up to spectacular four-bedroom penthouses, offering breathtaking views. Built with smart home automation for lighting and climate control, the residences offer peak modern convenience. Sustainability is prioritized through energy-saving LED fixtures and high-efficiency VRF HVAC technology. The interiors showcase premium craftsmanship, high-quality finishes, and expansive double-glazed thermal windows that frame the sea, park, or marina, providing an abundance of natural light. description: Reference: GTWW-T1354. The project is located in Business Bay, Dubai, next to the city's water canal, in a privileged location that offers easy access to the city's business, commerce and leisure centres. The architecture is built in three high-rise residential towers 48 floors with a contemporary design and typology designed for those looking to live in the urban heart, but with all the comforts of a modern development. The residential typologies cover a variety adapted to different lifestyles: studios, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. Each unit has been designed with floor-to-ceiling windows (where applicable) and balconies, with open layouts and high-end finishes, designed to maximise natural light intake and provide panoramic views of the canal, the urban skyline and iconic landmarks of the city. The amenities offered are spacious and aimed at a contemporary lifestyle with comfort, leisure and convenience. The development includes swimming pools (including infinity style), wellness and relaxation areas, modern gym, green areas and landscaped gardens, jogging tracks, sports spaces (sports courts, physical activity areas), outdoor social areas, children's play areas, and common facilities that promote a community and comfortable environment for those who live in the building. In addition, commercial shops, restaurants and retail options are planned on the ground floor and podium floors, which ensures convenience for residents and reduces the need to travel for daily services and shopping. The immediate proximity to the canal and the urban centre allows you to combine the tranquillity of a water zone with the energy of the city, ideal for those looking for a balance between modern living, comfort and accessibility. Taken together, this development represents a high-end residential proposal combining contemporary architecture, flexible typologies ranging from the studio to the 3-bedroom flat, sophisticated finishes, privileged views and a set of amenities that guarantee comfort, safety and quality of life. It is an option adaptable to both singles and couples as well as families, as well as investors looking for real estate development in one of Dubai's most central and dynamic neighbourhoods. #ref:8996

raw_area: 67JW+P2W - Za'abeel - Al Kifaf - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

Designed by internationally acclaimed architectural firm Gensler and developed by DarGlobal, DG1 combines sculptural architecture with a prime waterfront address beside the Dubai Canal, creating a landmark residential tower in the heart of Dubai. Although the tower enjoys a prestigious canal-side location, this particular residence benefits from an open city outlook, offering expansive urban views across Business Bay together with abundant natural light throughout the day. As one of only two remaining two-bedroom apartments currently available within the project, it represents an increasingly rare opportunity for buyers seeking a premium freehold property before completion. The generous 126 m² layout centres around a spacious open-plan living and dining area that connects seamlessly to the private balcony, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor living. Large floor-to-ceiling windows frame the surrounding cityscape while filling the interiors with natural daylight from multiple directions thanks to the apartment's desirable corner position. The contemporary kitchen integrates naturally with the living spaces, allowing the apartment to function equally well as a permanent residence, a second home or an investment property. Unlike many developments where every apartment follows an identical template, the corner configuration provides a noticeably brighter environment and a greater feeling of openness throughout the home. Landmark Architecture by Gensler DG1 Living has become one of the most distinctive additions to the Business Bay skyline. Rather than relying on conventional straight-line architecture, the building features flowing terraces and sculpted balconies that create movement throughout the façade. Designed by Gensler, one of the world's leading architectural firms, the tower has been conceived as a contemporary landmark overlooking the Dubai Canal. title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

description: Azizi Wasel is a contemporary waterfront residential development on Dubai Islands, offering an exceptional collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive four-bedroom penthouses. Defined by sleek architectural lines, expansive glass façades, and thoughtfully designed open spaces, the development embraces natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline further enhance its appeal, creating a sophisticated residential environment where modern design meets coastal tranquillity. The development offers a carefully selected range of amenities designed to complement a relaxed yet active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a fully equipped modern gym, landscaped gardens, and a multipurpose hall for community gatherings and social events. On-site retail outlets provide convenient access to everyday essentials, while dedicated children's play areas create a welcoming environment for families. Every feature is designed to balance leisure, convenience, and community living within an attractive waterfront setting. The interiors showcase contemporary design, quality materials, and refined finishes, creating comfortable and functional living spaces. Equipped kitchens add everyday practicality, while well-planned layouts maximise space and natural light. The residences are delivered unfurnished, giving homeowners the freedom to personalise their interiors while enjoying modern specifications and the appeal of waterfront living. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an ambitious coastal destination designed to bring together waterfront residences, leisure attractions, hospitality, and contemporary urban living. Comprising five interconnected islands, the master development features a distinctive blend of residential neighbourhoods, pristine beaches, landscaped spaces, and recreational destinations. Its coastal setting offers residents the opportunity to embrace a more relaxed lifestyle, complemented by scenic sea views and an atmosphere of seaside exclusivity. Connected to mainland Dubai through established road infrastructure, Dubai Islands combines the tranquillity of island living with access to the city's established commercial and lifestyle destinations. Residents can enjoy convenient connectivity to areas such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah, while the surrounding district continues to develop as a destination for waterfront leisure and hospitality. Planned attractions include upscale hotels, fine-dining restaurants, retail destinations, beach clubs, and recreational facilities, creating a vibrant environment for residents and visitors alike. Designed to offer a diverse lifestyle experience, Dubai Islands brings together peaceful residential settings and lively leisure destinations within one coastal masterplan. Its emphasis on landscaped environments, modern infrastructure, and integrated amenities contributes to its long-term appeal as a distinctive waterfront address. Combining coastal scenery, urban accessibility, and a growing selection of lifestyle attractions, Dubai Islands presents an appealing choice for those seeking a contemporary seaside lifestyle in Dubai.

There are homes you enter, and there are residences that make you feel as though you have stepped into another world.

Welcome to Villa del Garda, a first-row waterfront residence on Dubai Islands, where the calm of the marina meets the timeless elegance of Italian design.

With residences ranging from refined apartments to exceptional duplexes and private terrace-pool residences, Villa del Garda offers a rare interpretation of waterfront living — intimate, serviced and unmistakably sophisticated.

Set on Dubai Islands, just minutes from the city's established destinations, this is where the energy of Dubai meets the serenity of the sea.

Villa del Garda is not simply a residence by the water. It is a private expression of Italian elegance, where every arrival feels special and every day carries the atmosphere of a five-star retreat.

description: Safa Two by Damac Properties is an exclusive residential development that represents the second chapter of the developer's prestigious Nature of Luxury collection. Strategically located alongside Safa Park in Dubai, this iconic twin-tower development offers an exceptional selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Defined by its distinctive diamond-inspired architecture, the project features an extraordinary suspended hanging garden connecting the two towers, creating a remarkable architectural landmark on Dubai's skyline. Its grand entrance and elegant interiors, enhanced by jewel-inspired design elements, reflect a unique expression of contemporary luxury. Designed to deliver an elevated residential experience, Safa Two combines exceptional architecture with an impressive range of lifestyle amenities. Its signature hanging garden serves as the development's central attraction, offering residents a distinctive leisure environment above the city. Complemented by sophisticated communal spaces, beautifully designed lobbies, and access to the greenery of Safa Park, the development creates a perfect balance between luxury, relaxation, and urban convenience. Inspired by the iconic rubies of de Grisogono, the interiors feature rich scarlet accents that represent passion, energy, and sophistication. Each residence incorporates innovative transformative living spaces with movable walls, allowing homeowners to customize their layouts according to their lifestyle requirements. Premium finishes, carefully selected materials, and fully equipped kitchens with modern appliances further enhance the comfort and functionality of every apartment. Location Description & Benefits Located alongside Safa Park, one of Dubai's most established green destinations, Safa Two enjoys a prestigious address that combines central-city connectivity with peaceful natural surroundings. The development is ideally positioned between some of Dubai's most sought-after districts, including Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, and Jumeirah, offering residents convenient access to the city's key commercial, residential, and lifestyle destinations. The location provides excellent connectivity to major road networks, allowing seamless travel across Dubai. Residents can enjoy beautiful surroundings, including the Dubai Water Canal, landscaped parks, waterfront promenades, and scenic cycling tracks. The development also offers convenient access to iconic landmarks such as Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab, bringing some of the city's most recognizable attractions within easy reach. Safa Two is surrounded by an extensive selection of premium lifestyle destinations, including fine-dining restaurants, luxury shopping destinations, beach clubs, international schools, healthcare facilities, and wellness centers. Its strategic location offers the convenience of city living while maintaining a connection to nature and open spaces. With its distinctive architecture, innovative residential concepts, proximity to Safa Park, and connectivity to Dubai's prime destinations, Safa Two presents an attractive opportunity for both end-users and investors seeking a prestigious address in one of the city's most desirable locations.

title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

Set on the second floor of Aqua Arc on Al Marjan Island, this residence spans 1,217.93 sq ft (113.15 m²), combining an 850.99 sq ft interior with a remarkable 366.94 sq ft private balcony. More than thirty per cent of the property is dedicated to outdoor space, giving the apartment a scale and openness that its bedroom count alone does not reveal. Inside, the plan feels like a complete home rather than a compact holiday unit. The 3.0 by 2.2 metre kitchen leads naturally into a 5.8 by 4.0 metre living and dining room. This principal space is broad enough to accommodate defined lounge and dining settings, then opens directly onto the curved balcony for an effortless indoor-outdoor sequence. The bedroom measures 5.1 by 3.9 metres, allowing the sleeping area to retain a calm, well-proportioned character. It is supported by a generous 3.0 by 2.6 metre full bathroom. A separate guest powder room keeps visitors away from the private accommodation, while the dedicated laundry removes day-to-day utility from the kitchen. Together, these supporting spaces make the apartment far more suitable for extended stays than a typical one-bedroom layout. The balcony is the defining feature. At approximately 34.09 m², it has the proportions for open-air dining, a comfortable lounge arrangement and quiet private use without forcing every function into one narrow strip. Its curved edge follows Aqua Arc's wave-inspired architecture and gives the home a genuine outdoor room rather than a token balcony. The residence carries a community outlook. It is therefore best suited to a buyer who values interior scale, usable outdoor space and a calmer inward-facing position over a direct-sea premium. That distinction should be clear from the outset: the value here comes from proportion and liveability, not from an overstated view claim. Aqua Arc is designed as a contemporary waterfront address with flowing façades, landscaped arrival spaces and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. Al Marjan Island places the residence within Ras Al Khaimah's established waterfront and hospitality corridor. For an international second-home buyer, the oversized balcony and complete supporting rooms make the apartment practical beyond a short visit. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an emerging waterfront destination envisioned to bring together coastal beauty, contemporary communities, and diverse leisure experiences. With an extensive coastline stretching across five interconnected islands, the destination offers a distinctive setting for beachfront residences, hospitality developments, retail destinations, and recreational facilities. Its master-planned environment combines modern infrastructure with landscaped open spaces, creating an appealing balance between urban convenience and seaside tranquillity. The islands offer opportunities to enjoy a wide range of leisure experiences, from relaxing along sandy beaches to exploring waterfront promenades, marinas, and resort destinations. Water sports, yachting, outdoor recreation, parks, shopping, and dining contribute to a vibrant coastal lifestyle, offering experiences for individuals, couples, and families alike. Connectivity to mainland Dubai adds to the area's appeal. Road links and bridges connect the islands with established districts across the city, while nearby transport connections support access to key destinations. Alongside its commercial significance, the district's waterfront setting adds to its appeal as an emerging location for contemporary residential developments. Its strategic position provides convenient road access to established parts of Dubai, including Port Rashid, Downtown Dubai, and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Connections to major transport routes and nearby port facilities also support access to key commercial districts and international trade networks. Dubai Maritime City's combination of waterfront surroundings, commercial importance, and connectivity makes it an increasingly distinctive part of Dubai's urban landscape. description: Project general facts Interstellar Tower is a visionary addition to the urban skyline, distinguished by its sleek futuristic architecture and bold contemporary design. Its thoughtfully designed residences feature spacious layouts, expansive windows, and sophisticated interiors that maximize natural light while delivering a harmonious balance of comfort, style, and functionality. The circular layout of JVT ensures easy navigation, while the ample green spaces provide a peaceful retreat for residents seeking a serene lifestyle away from the city's hustle and bustle. JVT offers a wide array of amenities, catering to both families and individuals. Water features and landscaped gardens add to the charm of this tranquil community, making it an ideal choice for those looking to enjoy modern conveniences in a peaceful, green setting. Whether you're looking for a family-oriented community or a relaxing space to call home, JVT offers the perfect balance of lifestyle and location.

Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.
